packageRules.description: Major: separate PR per major version, no automerge.
prBodyNotes: Major bump: read the changelog, check the Cloudflare build and the versions in .nvmrc.

packageRules.description: Node (.nvmrc): major bumps are manual only, together with NODE_VERSION in Cloudflare.
@types/node: keep in line with the runtime from .nvmrc (22). Bump together with .nvmrc and NODE_VERSION in Cloudflare.
VitePress 2.x is published as alpha: allow pre-releases (and versions ahead of the latest tag) so Renovate proposes the move. Majors still follow the rule above.
